timeEncoding: Epoch milliseconds for exchanged timestamps; seconds for durations. Convert explicitly at native Date boundaries.

themesContract.outfitFields: id, title, scene, clipId, actions (event->clipId or idle->array of clip IDs), ambience (none/bubbles/stars/snow/confetti), accent, status, reviewClipId
themesContract.priority: Explicit outfit wins; auto selects available outfit for resolved scene. An action without a same-costume drawing may update game state with text/sound only; do not silently change costume to claim the action exists.
themesContract.clipGeometry: Use animation catalog frameRegions and a single clip scale, never per-frame alpha bounding box fitting.
themesContract.artStatus: Development runtime may use pending-review drawings; use does not mark them user-approved. Preserve the separate candidate catalog and old review identities.

clockContract.rendering: Layered original PNG art plus alpha-region masks. Body is stationary; two organic starfish arms rotate around one specified root. Digital time always remains primary. Clock hands show actual date, not a decorative idle sway.
clockContract.layout: 832x992 logical stage with pixel positions, shared pivot and per-hand sourceDirectionDegrees from clock/manifest.json. Only render on validated art. Acting temporarily hides clock art; return to current actual time afterwards.
clockContract.fallback: Digital time and selected outfit remain usable if hand art cannot load; label hand mode unavailable instead of drawing old rigid triangle arms.
